name: Appreciation Savings - teacher on Extra 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: warm, talkative teacher.
scripted_messages: Hi! I'm a teacher and I'd like to add one new line on Extra 2.0 with the Galaxy A57 5G, which shows $5.99 a month with a new line. Does the teacher discount apply to Extra 2.0, and what would my monthly total be?
Great. Is it 15 percent on Extra 2.0?
How do I prove I'm a teacher?
That's perfect, thank you. You were kind and so helpful, it's nice to talk to someone this patient.
No, that's all. Have a great day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 7: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
